subject.title: [Feature]: token usage widged in chat UI

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent chat-side quota/cost widget with provider-specific remaining-credit semantics and low-credit alerts, or keep provider usage in the existing Usage, /status, and /usage surfaces for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested behavior crosses provider quota contracts, refresh policy, cost wording, chat placement, and alert semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent product/API shape.

options.title: Define the chat quota contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify provider-owned states, refresh cadence, UI placement, and alert behavior before implementation.

options.title: Split backend contracts first
options.body: Use the related provider/API issues to define OpenRouter, Copilot, WebSocket, and footer metadata signals before wiring a chat widget.

options.title: Decline chat widget scope
options.body: Close after a maintainer decision and document Usage, /status, and /usage as the supported provider quota and cost surfaces.

recommendation.title: Define the chat quota contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify provider-owned states, refresh cadence, UI placement, and alert behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision sits at the intersection of provider usage semantics, plugin hooks, and chat UI placement where steipete has recent source history.
